# US-003: Sign out

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to sign out, so that nobody else can use my session on a shared device.

## Context

Not drawn on the board; implied by sign-in. Placement and wording TBD.

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-auth-access-011](../srs/auth-access-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Sign out |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Sign out

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-auth-access-011
- **Screen:** landing

```gherkin
Given a signed-in user
When the user chooses Sign out
Then the session ends and the Login screen is shown
```

### AC-002 — No way back after sign-out

- **Type:** permission
- **Covers:** FR-auth-access-011, FR-auth-access-009

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: project content after sign-out
Given a user has signed out
When the user <action>
Then no project content is shown
And the Login screen is shown

Examples:
  | action                                       |
  | presses the browser Back button              |
  | pastes a project page URL copied before       |
```

### AC-003 — Secure connection

- **Type:** non-functional
- **Covers:** NFR-auth-access-001

```gherkin
Given the portal address with "http://"
When it is opened
Then the portal is served only over https (redirect or refusal: TBD)
```

Lockout and session expiry: **blocked by spec OQ-3, OQ-4** (NFR-auth-access-005).
